subtitle: The combination that makes a parameter actually do something

caption: Typed like any other field — Tableau's autocomplete offers the parameter alongside dimensions and measures.

code:
// Stock Status
IF SUM([Quantity]) < [Reorder Threshold]
THEN "Reorder Now"
ELSE "Stock OK"
END
caption: [Reorder Threshold] is a Range parameter — moving its slider recolors the whole view.

subtitle: Letting one parameter swap which field a whole view is built on
